description: S50 T5 (RM8, TD2) — the agent's ONE ask of the roadmap, answered. roadmap_propose_idea is a catalog tool and this is its socket twin: the same records service that answers the tool answers the method, so the bytes are the same answer rather than a second rendering of it (rule 4). What the answer is: a PROPOSAL row, `status: proposed`, authored by the AGENT the step belongs to (`createdByKind: agent` — the ask is the model's, and saying so is the audit), carrying WHICH IDEA (the component root it plans, the title a board will render, the optional epic tag) and the NOTE the person reads before deciding. The `note` is the fixed inertness statement — `protocol.PolicyProposeInertNote`, one definition in the code and this fixture its wire copy — because an ask adds nothing: no item stands on the board, no status or priority or size is set, nothing is enforced until a person runs the `command` this answer names, and THEN the item is theirs — created by roadmap's own create with provenance authored, the COMMITTER as actor, one audit line. An ask naming a root that is no component, or re-asking an idea the board already carries open, is refused at create by the same door the commit re-runs (TD3 — see roadmap-propose/propose-idea-refuses-a-smuggled-status.json for the door's other half); and there is no propose-update, -cancel, -estimate, -priority or -dispatch ask to file at all: an idea may only be ADDED, and the ladder, the size and the start stay the person's (RM8, T4's guards).
